title: Instagram Moves to Label AI Profiles That Pretend to Be Human
dek: Instagram is renaming its AI creator label and says it will limit the reach of accounts that fail to disclose AI-generated personas.
socialCaption: Instagram will label profiles featuring AI-generated people and says accounts that do not disclose may face limited distribution. For virtual-influencer operators, transparency is becoming a reach and brand-safety issue.
